The '''Court of Disputes''' was a large room that was located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and outsiders met to resolve matters of personal concern.<ref name="PotJS" />
